Messages.Author: medborgareF
Messages.Body:
Hi all,
I'm wondering if the mummies created by spell of life contest with the vampire of the same name or only other mummies?

Spell of Life

Action

Follower of Set

+1 stealth action.
Put this card in play. Only one Spell of Life may be played each turn. You may burn five Spells of Life to put up to five vampires from your uncontrolled region in play. Each represents a unique mummy ally with life equal to capacity, 1 bleed and 2 strength who can enter combat with a minion as a  action.

thx in advance /F

Messages.Author: Brum
Messages.Body:
Any card that is Unique contests by name and name only.
So a future "Sengir Dagger" unique Vampire will context with the weapon that was released in 1994 in Jyhad.

So yeah, Seterpenre the Unique Mummy will contest with Seterpenre the Vampire.

Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: finbury
Messages.Body: Huh. So, if I have two Embraces in play and one is Banished and comes back as a mummy via Spell of Life, they won't contest? And if I have two Banished Enbraces in my uncontrolled region and burn my Spells of Life, I'd only be able to choose one of them?

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> finbury wrote:
> Huh. So, if I have two Embraces in play and one is Banished and comes back as a mummy via Spell of Life, they won't contest?
>
Right. One is non-unique, one is unique. A non-unique card won't contest.

If there two Embraces in play from Spell of Life, they'd contest each other. (Which means you can't voluntarily do it yourself. But you could if someone else did it.)

See the same situation with Aabbt Kindred.  [LSJ 20070928]

> finbury wrote:
> And if I have two Banished Enbraces in my uncontrolled region and burn my Spells of Life, I'd only be able to choose one of them?
>
Right. Rulebook 4.1.

Messages.Author: CelestialChoir
Messages.Body:
It seems like they are using crypt cards to proxy create unique mummy allies, and not actually mummifing a vampire. Spell of Life in canon was used by Isis to create mummies, and has no involvement with vampires. Absimiliards Army does a similar thing, but having a Dummy Corporation ally doesn't contest Dummy Corporations in play. I wouldn't think a mummy and vampire would contest, even with the same name.
I understand that is the ruling... it just makes me sad
